name: Nekoneko Jikken Kansatsu Russian Blue
original_name: ねこねこじっけんかんさつ　－ロシアンブルー－
source:
Dr.Cat explores cats through experiments. His first experiment answers question of what happens if a cute cat-girl is put into a closed room with a lot of sexually agitated men.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
猫博士通过实验探索猫。他的第一个实验回答了这样一个问题：如果将一个可爱的猫女孩放入一个封闭的房间，里面有很多性兴奋的男人，会发生什么。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
